# Stock Analysis

> > Comprehensive stock market research platform providing financial data, industry analysis, and investment education across NASDAQ, NYSE, CBOE, and global exchanges.

Stock Analysis offers detailed stock screening tools, industry classifications, financial metrics definitions, and investment guides. The platform covers U.S. and international markets including exchanges in Germany, Japan, Portugal, and Sweden, with data-driven resources for long-term investors.

## Key Topics

- Stock screening and market cap analysis
- Industry classifications and sector analysis
- Financial metrics (ROE, dividend payout ratio, cost of revenue)
- NASDAQ, NYSE, and CBOE listed securities
- ETFs and long-term investing strategies
- International exchanges (Euronext, Nordic Growth Market)
- Transportation and industrials sectors
- Capital markets and financial services
- Net income and profitability analysis
- Investment education and brokerage reviews
- Real estate and appreciating assets
- Pre-IPO and secondary market investing
- Environmental and specialty chemicals industries
- Retail and consumer sectors

## Financial Metrics & Terminology

- [Return on Equity (ROE): Formula, Definition, and How to Use](https://stockanalysis.com/term/roe-return-on-equity): ROE profitability metric formula and investment analysis guide
- [Dividend Payout Ratio: Meaning, Formulas, and Examples](https://stockanalysis.com/term/dividend-payout-ratio): Dividend payout ratio calculation and sustainability analysis guide
- [Cost of Revenue: Definition, Examples, and Formula](https://stockanalysis.com/term/cost-of-revenue): Financial term explaining cost of revenue vs COGS with examples
